sections.heading: Proposal
sections.body:
- One registry owns the widget list.
- The loader and the renderer both read it.

sections.heading: Out of Scope
sections.body: - none — the boundary is the widget list, and nothing else was near it.

sections.heading: Impact
sections.body:
### Standards this spec will write into /.docs/standards/

- `/.docs/standards/architecture/widget-registry.md` — one registry owns the list

### Standards at `authority: background` this spec may resolve

- none

### Product code this spec expects to touch

- `src/widgets/loader.py` — reads the registry instead of its own list

sections.heading: Design
sections.body: - The registry is a module-level dict, built once at import — the two readers are in-process.

sections.heading: Handoff
sections.body: The registry lives in `src/widgets/registry.py`. Both readers import it; neither builds a list.

sections.heading: Tasks
sections.body:
